description: This file contains benchmark tests for various container data structures in the Abseil library, including btree_set, btree_map, and other container types, focusing on performance metrics such as insertion, lookup, deletion, and iterator operations.

classes.name: BigType
classes.description: A customizable large value type used for benchmarking container performance with different data sizes and move costs.

classes.name: BigTypePtr
classes.description: A wrapper around a unique_ptr to BigType, used for benchmarking container performance with large, heap-allocated objects.

methods.name: GenerateValues
methods.description: Generates a vector of values in the range [0, 4 * n], with seed 23.

methods.name: BM_InsertImpl
methods.description: Benchmarks insertion and re-insertion of values into a container, with optional sorting.

methods.name: BM_Insert
methods.description: Runs the insertion benchmark without sorting.

methods.name: BM_InsertSorted
methods.description: Runs the insertion benchmark with sorted input.

methods.name: BM_InsertSmall
methods.description: Benchmarks inserting a small number of elements into a container, simulating root node growth in a B-tree.

methods.name: BM_LookupImpl
methods.description: Benchmarks lookup performance in a container, with optional sorted input.

methods.name: BM_FullLookup
methods.description: Runs the lookup benchmark on a fully-inserted container.

methods.name: BM_Erase
methods.description: Benchmarks erasing and re-inserting values in a container.

methods.name: BM_EraseRange
methods.description: Benchmarks range erasure and reinsertion of values.

methods.name: BM_EraseIf
methods.description: Benchmarks erasing elements based on a predicate.

methods.name: BM_QueueAddRem
methods.description: Simulates queue-like insertions and removals in a container.

methods.name: BM_MixedAddRem
methods.description: Benchmarks mixed insertion and removal of values.

methods.name: BM_FwdIter
methods.description: Iterates forward through a container to benchmark traversal performance.

methods.name: BM_RangeConstructionImpl
methods.description: Benchmarks constructing containers from a range of values, sorted or unsorted.

methods.name: BM_InsertRangeRandom
methods.description: Runs range construction benchmark with random order.

methods.name: BM_InsertRangeSorted
methods.description: Runs range construction benchmark with sorted input.

methods.name: ContainerInfo
methods.description: Calculates container memory usage and logs info for BigType and BigTypePtr.
